host.name: MakerSquare
host.description: Austin's school of applied AI. In-person builder programs for non-technical professionals: a 2-week immersive cohort, 3-day weekend workshops, and private team training. Students ship a live website, an AI agent, and an automated workflow.

entries.description: Condensed, agent-readable summary of MakerSquare: what the program is, who it is for, what students build, pricing, cohort and workshop dates, location, and enrollment.
